triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_allocations_guard_payment_delete BEFORE DELETE ON transactions WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_allocations WHERE payment_transaction_id = OLD.id AND status = 'active') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El pago tiene imputaciones activas: reviértelas antes de eliminarlo'); END

triggers.name: installment_allocations_guard_payment_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_allocations_guard_payment_update BEFORE UPDATE ON transactions WHEN ((OLD.amount IS NOT NEW.amount OR OLD.currency IS NOT NEW.currency OR OLD.type IS NOT NEW.type OR OLD.direction IS NOT NEW.direction OR OLD.status IS NOT NEW.status OR OLD.account_id IS NOT NEW.account_id OR OLD.target_account_id IS NOT NEW.target_account_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_allocations WHERE payment_transaction_id = OLD.id AND status = 'active')) OR (OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_allocations WHERE payment_transaction_id = OLD.id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El pago tiene imputaciones activas: reviértelas antes de modificarlo'); END

triggers.name: installment_allocations_guard_purchase_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_allocations_guard_purchase_delete BEFORE DELETE ON installment_purchases WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_allocations WHERE installment_purchase_id = OLD.id AND status = 'active') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'La compra tiene imputaciones activas: reviértelas antes de eliminarla'); END

triggers.name: installment_allocations_transition
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_allocations_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON installment_allocations WHEN NOT (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status = 'reversed' AND NEW.reversed_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.payment_transaction_id IS OLD.payment_transaction_id AND NEW.installment_purchase_id IS OLD.installment_purchase_id AND NEW.amount_cents IS OLD.amount_cents AND NEW.mode IS OLD.mode AND NEW.command_id IS OLD.command_id AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Una imputación solo puede pasar de activa a revertida'); END

triggers.name: installment_allocations_validate_insert
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_allocations_validate_insert BEFORE INSERT ON installment_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Una imputación nueva debe estar activa') WHERE NEW.status <> 'active'; SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'La compra a cuotas imputada no existe') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_purchases WHERE id = NEW.installment_purchase_id); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El pago imputado no existe o no corresponde a la tarjeta de la compra') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions t JOIN installment_purchases p ON p.id = NEW.installment_purchase_id WHERE t.id = NEW.payment_transaction_id AND t.type = 'creditCardPayment' AND t.target_account_id = p.account_id AND t.currency = p.currency); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El comando ya imputó otro pago') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_allocations WHERE command_id = NEW.command_id AND payment_transaction_id <> NEW.payment_transaction_id); END

triggers.name: installment_history_guard_purchase_id
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_history_guard_purchase_id BEFORE UPDATE OF id ON installment_purchases WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_allocations WHERE installment_purchase_id = OLD.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = OLD.id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'La compra tiene historial de cuotas y no puede cambiar de identificador'); END

triggers.name: installment_plan_revisions_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_plan_revisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON installment_plan_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'El historial de revisiones es de solo inserción'); END

triggers.name: installment_plan_revisions_purchase_edit
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_plan_revisions_purchase_edit AFTER UPDATE ON installment_purchases WHEN (OLD.total_amount IS NOT NEW.total_amount OR OLD.installment_count IS NOT NEW.installment_count OR OLD.currency IS NOT NEW.currency OR OLD.account_id IS NOT NEW.account_id OR OLD.transaction_id IS NOT NEW.transaction_id OR OLD.first_due_date IS NOT NEW.first_due_date) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = NEW.id) BEGIN INSERT INTO installment_plan_revisions (id, installment_purchase_id, revision_number, source, allocation_id, remaining_principal_cents, remaining_installments, installment_amount_cents, effective_cycle_end, verification, pending_reasons, basis_total_amount, basis_monthly_amount, basis_installment_count, created_at) SELECT NEW.id || ':revision:' || (MAX(revision_number) + 1), NEW.id, MAX(revision_number) + 1, 'purchaseEdit', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'pendingVerification', 'termsChanged', NEW.total_amount, NEW.monthly_amount, NEW.installment_count, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = NEW.id; END

triggers.name: installment_plan_revisions_purchase_removal
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_plan_revisions_purchase_removal AFTER DELETE ON installment_purchases WHEN (SELECT source FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = OLD.id ORDER BY revision_number DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT source FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = OLD.id ORDER BY revision_number DESC LIMIT 1) <> 'purchaseRemoval' BEGIN INSERT INTO installment_plan_revisions (id, installment_purchase_id, revision_number, source, allocation_id, remaining_principal_cents, remaining_installments, installment_amount_cents, effective_cycle_end, verification, pending_reasons, basis_total_amount, basis_monthly_amount, basis_installment_count, created_at) SELECT OLD.id || ':revision:' || (MAX(revision_number) + 1), OLD.id, MAX(revision_number) + 1, 'purchaseRemoval', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'pendingVerification', 'purchaseRemoved', NULL, NULL, NULL, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = OLD.id; END

triggers.name: installment_plan_revisions_validate_insert
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER installment_plan_revisions_validate_insert BEFORE INSERT ON installment_plan_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Número de revisión fuera de secuencia') WHERE NEW.revision_number IS NOT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(revision_number) + 1 FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = NEW.installment_purchase_id), 0); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'La compra a cuotas de la revisión no existe') WHERE NEW.source <> 'purchaseRemoval' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_purchases WHERE id = NEW.installment_purchase_id); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Solo una compra eliminada admite una revisión de eliminación') WHERE NEW.source = 'purchaseRemoval' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installment_purchases WHERE id = NEW.installment_purchase_id); SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Tras una eliminación el historial debe reiniciarse con una revisión original') WHERE NEW.source <> 'original' AND (SELECT source FROM installment_plan_revisions WHERE installment_purchase_id = NEW.installment_purchase_id ORDER BY revision_number DESC LIMIT 1) = 'purchaseRemoval'; END
